R15 phase-1 v1 normative byte examples (little-endian; not executable tests).
Examples are independent, not a sequential replay. LOCATION requires active sharing/anchor/coverage, not a preceding STOP. The full DATA example requires MTU>=119 (e.g.247); fragment it for MTU96.
Context vehicle=1, BLE token=2, display=3. CRC32/ISO-HDLC.

REJECT truncation: remove any byte from a complete record; do not refresh TTL.
ORDER: exact retry of last control is idempotent; changed bytes with same sequence rejected.
TIME: age>=2000ms, anchor age>=30000ms, receipt age>=2000ms each hide marker.
SESSION: reconnect/vehicle boot/display boot invalidates staging, anchors and sequences.
PACKAGE: extra/truncated body, invalid count/kind/name/bounds fail without replacing active map.
ACCURACY LIMITED: LOCATION body quality=3, flags=5 (precise but low accuracy), fix/coordinates=0, accuracy=ffffffff, course/courseAccuracy/speed=ffff; display LOW_ACCURACY, no marker. Approximate permission uses flags=4. Never set accuracy-limited with Available or mock.
